description: Scala source code defining the JsonScan class, which extends TextBasedFileScan to implement JSON data source scanning in Apache Spark. It manages options, schema validation, splitability, and creates partition reader factories for JSON data.

classes.name: JsonScan
classes.description: A case class extending TextBasedFileScan, implementing JSON data source scanning with schema validation, splitability checks, and partition reader factory creation.

methods.name: isSplitable
methods.description: Determines if the JSON file at the given path can be split, based on JsonDataSource settings and superclass logic.

methods.name: getFileUnSplittableReason
methods.description: Provides a reason why a file cannot be split, primarily if JSON multiline mode is enabled.

methods.name: createReaderFactory
methods.description: Creates a PartitionReaderFactory after verifying column requirements and broadcasting Hadoop configurations.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality of this JsonScan instance with another object, considering schema, options, and filters.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code for this JsonScan instance.

methods.name: getMetaData
methods.description: Returns metadata about the scan, including pushed filters.
